newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OMNI INDUSTRIES BUYS STAKE IN DESIGN FIRM.
newsitem.headline: OMNI INDUSTRIES BUYS STAKE IN DESIGN FIRM.

text.p: Omni Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it would acquire 33.3 percent of Aris Designtools Pte Ltd, which makes prototypes for new products in telecommunications, computers and consumer electronics.
It said in a statement the group's stake would be acquired from Wuthelam International Investment Ltd for Singapore $208,643.
The company also said it would incorporate a wholly-owned subsidiary to undertake contract manufacturing in Shanghai, China.
It plans to develop a fully integrated manufacturing facility in Shanghai to house the group's two companies there -- Omni Plastics Shanghai and Omni Electronics Shanghai.
Until the new factory is completed, Omni Electronics Shanghai will start operations in rented premises in the fourth quarter this year, it said.
